item.title: Middle East Eye: Israel reportedly kills Education Ministry official in central Gaza
item.description: Israel reportedly kills Education Ministry official in central Gaza Israel has killed the undersecretary of the Ministry of Education, Khaled Abu Nada, alongside his wife in west Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, according to Al Jazeera.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli strikes kill at least 16 Palestinians across Gaza over past day
item.description: Israeli strikes kill at least 16 Palestinians across Gaza over past day An Al Jazeera count of the death toll has estimated that at least 16 Palestinians have been killed in various Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip over the past 24 hours. Israeli strikes and shelling in the besieged enclave has intensified in recent times despite a ceasefire that has been in place since October last year.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Houthi shelling reportedly kills woman in Yemen's Taiz
item.description: Houthi shelling reportedly kills woman in Yemen's Taiz Houthi shelling south east of Yemen's Taiz has killed a woman and wounded at least seven others, including a child, the government-run Saba news agency reported.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Watch: Netanyahu demands immediate end to corruption trial after judges cast doubt
item.description: Watch: Netanyahu demands immediate end to corruption trial after judges cast doubt Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called on Wednesday for an immediate end to his long-running corruption trial after judges cast doubt on the charges and recommended dropping a case in which he is accused of bribery. The judges’ recommendations came as Israel’s longest-serving prime minister fights for his political survival following the inconclusive elections on 27 October. Israeli caretaker…

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli strike on apartment kills two in central Gaza
item.description: Israeli strike on apartment kills two in central Gaza An Israeli air strike targeting a residential apartment in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, has killed at least two and wounded several others, Al Jazeera reported.

item.title: Middle East Eye: US envoy Kushner confirms meeting with Iranian representatives 'a couple times'
item.description: US envoy Kushner confirms meeting with Iranian representatives 'a couple times' US envoy Jared Kushner has confirmed meeting with Iranian representatives on several occasions. "We met with the Iranians a couple times," he said. Kushner added that had worked under Vice President JD Vance to help president Donald Trump reach an outcome.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Latest Israeli attack in Gaza City reportedly kills three
item.description: Latest Israeli attack in Gaza City reportedly kills three At least three Palestinians have been reportedly killed in an Israeli drone attack on the Shati refugee camp, west of Gaza City, according to Al Jazeera citing medical sources. Earlier, another Israeli drone strike had targeted a group of civilians in the Tuffah neighbourhood, located east of the city, killing three.

item.description: Two drones intercepted in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region, Saudi-led coalition says The Saudi-led coalition's spokesperson said in a post on X that two drones were intercepted and destroyed in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israel has turned Gaza into a 'toxic wasteland'
item.description: Israel has turned Gaza into a 'toxic wasteland' A new report, “Environmental War Crimes”, by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory finds that Israel’s genocide on the Gaza Strip has turned it into a “toxic wasteland.” Bushra Khalidi, the Humanitarian Policy and Advocacy Lead at Oxfam, joins MEE LIVE to discuss the findings and what it means for the daily lives of Palestinians.

item.title: Middle East Eye: UKMTO reports explosion near tanker west of Dubai
item.description: UKMTO reports explosion near tanker west of Dubai The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency said it had received a report of an explosion caused by an unknown projectile near a tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai in the UAE on Thursday. The tanker's master reported the explosion, but the vessel sustained no damage and there was no environmental impact, UKMTO said in an advisory note, adding all crew members were safe and accounted for.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli strike kills worker with UN Palestinian agency in Gaza, agency says
item.description: Israeli strike kills worker with UN Palestinian agency in Gaza, agency says An Israeli airstrike killed a Gaza man working for the UN Palestinian refugee agency UNRWA in the Gaza Strip on Monday, the relief agency and local health officials said. The man, whom medics named as Adel Al-Helo, was working near a water well in the Jabalia refugee camp in the enclave's north, UNRWA and medics said. item.description: Israeli army demolishes one of the last Palestinian communities in Jordan Valley The Israeli army has destroyed one of the last Palestinian communities in the Jordan Valley in the occupied West Bank. item.title: Middle East Eye: Tehran dismisses 'dirty bomb' plot claims from US
item.description: Tehran dismisses 'dirty bomb' plot claims from US Tehran has dismissed claims published by CNN that it was planning to stage a "dirty bomb" attack in the US “After the nuclear lie, the Americans have resorted to the dirty bomb claim,” Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei told Tasnim news agency. “These claims are an attempt to evade accountability to public opinion for launching an illegal and unjust war against Iran.”

item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran says will use 'all available means' to counter US blockade
item.description: Iran says will use 'all available means' to counter US blockade Iran said on Monday that it would use all means at its disposal to counter a US naval blockade that was imposed in retaliation for its own push to block the Strait of Hormuz. "We will certainly not tolerate these actions and will use all available means to counter US aggression," said foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei in a weekly press briefing. Reporting by AFP

item.title: Middle East Eye: Saudi attack on Yemen's Hodeidah kills four, wounds 18 others
item.description: Saudi attack on Yemen's Hodeidah kills four, wounds 18 others A Saudi attack on Yemen's key port city of Hodeidah killed at least four people and injured 18 others, according to Houthi-affiliated media. The strike reportedly targeted a building belonging to Yemen's Public Telecommunications Corporation.

item.title: Middle East Eye: South Korea asks Qatar for priority supply of LNG supplies once transits through Hormuz Strait return to normal
item.description: South Korea asks Qatar for priority supply of LNG supplies once transits through Hormuz Strait return to normal South Korea has requested that Qatar prioritise liquefied natural gas (LNG) supplies to the country once production and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz return to normal. Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan asked Qatar's Minister of State for Energy Affairs Saad Sherida al-Kaabi during a meeting in Seoul, describing the Gulf country as a key energy partner.

item.description: Report: Netanyahu calls on Trump to launch attack on Iran 'as soon as possible' Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Trump to carry out strikes on Iran "as soon as possible", according to Israel’s public broadcaster Kan.
